test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven employees of a company-Chandan, Ayyappan, Sukesh, Rekha, Ankit, Madhavi, Sadhvi-are seated around a circular conference table facing the centre.

1. Chandan is between Ayyappan and Sukesh.

2. Rekha, who is second to the right of Sukesh, is between Ankit and Madhavi.

3. Ankit is not the neighbour of Sadhvi.

Which of the following statement is WRONG?

options.text: Ankit is to the immediate left of Rekha.
Sadhvi is third to the right of Ankit.
Rekha is to the immediate right of Madhavi.
Madhavi is third to the right of Sukesh.

solution:
**Seven employees: **Chandan, Ayyappan, Sukesh, Rekha, Ankit, Madhavi and Sadhavi.

1) Chandan is between Ayyappan and Sukesh.

(There are two cases is possible for sitting arrangement)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1157dc9b807cd26381ef90beaca873cad260ef79822ba5760d10daf70bfb6e37.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a771e6b78a8d41b26400774e40828743c70367f0a99053746e3db9fb9ae1c76.png] 

2) Rekha, who is second to the right of Sukesh, is between Ankit and Madhavi.

(From this statement only Case-1 are left, because Rekha is second right of Sukesh, and it is only possible in Case-1)

3)Ankit is not the neighbour of Sadhvi.

(It means Ankit can sit immediate right of Sukesh and Sadhavi sit between Madhuari and Ayyappan, because all place are reserved)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8df6e76e9f7ada61347a9cd76bd193a15e779db1508d46a02688b8e164409971.png] 

From the final sitting arrangement "Rekha is not sitting immediate right of Madhavi".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
